name: UQ Queensland Commitment Scholarship
summary: Living-cost scholarship for new UQ undergraduates who get the maximum Financial Hardship adjustment through QTAC's Educational Access Scheme.
key: The Queensland Commitment Scholarship provides $7,000 per year to help with living costs while you study full time.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident (including humanitarian visas) or New Zealand citizen.
Commencing a UQ undergraduate program, with no prior bachelor-level study.
Received the maximum 5 adjustment points in the Financial Hardship category of QTAC's Educational Access Scheme (EAS).
how: Apply for your program through QTAC, then apply for EAS and select the Financial Hardship category.
catches: Formerly called the UQ Link Scholarship.
Recipients can also be considered for the Aspire Scholarship scheme.
